page_title: EVE 2-0 LIV | Everton v Liverpool 24/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) fires a volley towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.
90+4' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Chermiti (Everton) is coming onto the pitch as Dominic Calvert-Lewin cannot continue after picking up an injury.
90+4' A yellow-coloured card is received by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool).
90+3' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Andy Madley lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
90+3' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.

90' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Jordan Pickford pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going in off the crossbar. Corner kick. Liverpool will have an opportunity.
90' Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool) takes the corner but it's cleared.
89' Ashley Young (Everton) fires the ball from the free kick just outside the box, but he misdirects his shot high over the bar.
88' Referee Andy Madley sees the trip by Wataru Endo (Liverpool) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Everton have a free kick from a promising distance.
86' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) tackles a bit over-zealously and Andy Madley blows for a foul.
84' Jurgen Klopp decides to make a substitution. Andrew Robertson will be replaced by Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Trent Alexander-Arnold departs the field of play to be replaced by Joe Gomez (Liverpool).
83' Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
81' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
80' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Jack Harrison (Everton) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.
79' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
78' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) commits a rough foul. Andy Madley stops the game and makes a call.
76' The linesman signals that Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
75' Substitution. Idrissa Gueye makes way for Amadou Onana (Everton).
73' The ball possession is 23:77.
71' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
71' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
70' OFF THE POST! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
69' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jordan Pickford intercepts the ball.
68' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

68' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sprays a pass out to Mohamed Salah, but he can't beat his man inside the box. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
67' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) blows a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the left post.
66' Dwight McNeil (Everton) is about to take a corner kick.
66' Dwight McNeil (Everton) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. Everton have been awarded a corner kick.

65' James Garner (Everton) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Good work from Everton as they win a corner.
64' Everton take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Dwight McNeil (Everton) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Everton win a corner.
63' Ibrahima Konate comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jarell Quansah (Liverpool).
63' Here is a change. Dominik Szoboszlai is going off and Jurgen Klopp gives the last tactical orders to Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
63' Today's match ends for Curtis Jones who will be replaced by Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
63' Jack Harrison (Everton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Andy Madley stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
62' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
62' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Liverpool.
60' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) commits a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.

58' 2 - 0 Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:0.
58' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

57' Dwight McNeil (Everton) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the underside of the crossbar is, however, superbly saved by Alisson! Everton force a corner. They send men into the box.

56' He should have scored! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Jordan Pickford makes an easy save.

56' He should have scored! Idrissa Gueye (Everton) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Alisson makes an easy save.
53' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
53' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
52' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
52' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
52' The corner from Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is cleared away by the defence.
51' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
48' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
48' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
47' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. Liverpool have a corner.
46' Sean Dyche makes a switch. Ashley Young is coming on in place of Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) at the start of the second period.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Andy Madley blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+6' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45+5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool).

45+5' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper, but his effort is straight at Jordan Pickford, who is alert and makes an easy save to deny him.
45+4' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
45+4' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45+4' The game is interrupted as Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is flagged offside.

45+1' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

44' Great save! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Jordan Pickford. Liverpool force their opponents to concede a corner.
44' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
41' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

40' It seemed like Dwight McNeil (Everton) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates. James Tarkowski (Everton) commits a foul during an attacking move.
37' The main referee, Andy Madley, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is given a yellow card for dissent.
37' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Andy Madley blows for a foul. Everton will take a free kick near the side line.

35' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
35' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
35' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
34' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
32' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
30' Andy Madley sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
28' The Everton players halt their celebrations as referee Andy Madley makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
27' 1 - 0 Goal! Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:0.
27' The free kick is taken by Dwight McNeil (Everton), but ball is cleared. Ben Godfrey (Everton) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
26' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Andy Madley blows his whistle for an infringement.
26' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
25' Andy Madley blows for a foul after Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
23' Liverpool have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
22' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Liverpool comes to nothing.
22' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
21' Jordan Pickford is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool). Easy save!
20' James Tarkowski (Everton) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Alisson keeps it out.
19' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
17' A header by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) from very close range goes towards the top right corner, but doesn't get past Alisson, who makes a brilliant save.
17' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is penalised for holding. Andy Madley signals a set piece.
15' 27:73 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

13' Dwight McNeil (Everton) is going to send the ball in from the free kick. Ben Godfrey (Everton) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches wide of the right post.
13' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Everton earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
11' Andy Madley blows his whistle and signals a foul after Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) brought his opponent down.
11' The resulting set piece from Liverpool is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
10' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Liverpool get a corner.
9' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Mohamed Salah, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
8' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Andy Madley changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
6' Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul after Alisson (Liverpool) hacks down one of his opponents. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Everton!
6' Dwight McNeil (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
5' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.

3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jack Harrison (Everton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) gets to a rebound inside the goalmouth, but even from this distance he misses the target and fails to score.
3' Poor challenge! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is penalised for tripping and Andy Madley blows his whistle.
2' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) picks up a long through ball, but Jordan Pickford deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Everton will take the kick-off.
Andy Madley is introduced as the referee for today's match.
